title: Some PlayerMobs wear their gear, and Weapon Master plays nicely
summary: Now and then a PlayerMob wears some of what it carries: a sword slung across its back, a shield, a pickaxe at its hip, arrows over a shoulder. Most don't, so one that does is worth a second look. If you use YDM's Weapon Master, its settings key now stays quiet in creative, where V opens the builder's block menu.
highlights: About 1 in 8 PlayerMobs show some of the weapons, tools, shield, banner or arrows they carry, and a few show several
YDM's Weapon Master settings no longer open on V in creative; in survival they work as before
